explanation: The originally boarded terms did not include the admitted Amendment No. 2, which permitted an add-back of fuel hedging mark-to-market losses up to $800,000. Applying this add-back with a cap to the Q2 2026 financials increases the numerator. The last dscr_calculator call on the corrected terms returned a DSCR of 1.30 (calc_id d8304d27-da90-4cfa-8370-bf5e1f2135c4), which matches the borrower's reported figure in the Q2 2026 compliance certificate (quoted). The amended covenant's terms are effective before the test period end, so this correction is valid and resolves the exception.
confidence_basis: The amendment effective April 1, 2026 allows an additional fuel hedging loss add-back capped at $800,000, which when applied to the Q2 2026 financials raises the DSCR to 1.30, passing the 1.25 minimum.
